Selected publications are organized for quick scanning by search committees, collaborators, and conservation-science partners. Tags highlight major research themes; DOI links are included where available.

## Selected / Flagship Papers

::: {.publication-list}
::: {.publication}
::: {.pub-meta}
**First author** · *Nature Climate Change* · 2022
:::

### Towards climate-smart, three-dimensional protected areas for biodiversity conservation in the high seas.

**Brito-Morales I**, Schoeman DS, Everett J, Klein CJ, Dunn D, Garcia Molinos J, Burrows MT, Buenafe KCV, Dominguez RM, Possingham HP, Richardson AJ. *Nature Climate Change* 12, 402-407.

::: {.tag-row}
`climate adaptation` `conservation planning` `high seas` `spatial ecology`
:::

**Significance:** Advances climate-smart, depth-aware protected-area design for biodiversity conservation in the high seas.

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41558-022-01323-7)
:::

::: {.publication}
::: {.pub-meta}
**First author** · *Nature Climate Change* · 2020
:::

### Climate velocity reveals increasing exposure of deep-ocean biodiversity to future warming.

**Brito-Morales I**, Schoeman DS, Garcia Molinos J, Burrows MT, Klein CJ, Arafeh-Dalmau N, Kaschner K, Garilao C, Kesner-Reyes K, Richardson AJ. *Nature Climate Change* 10, 576-581.

::: {.tag-row}
`climate velocity` `marine biodiversity` `deep ocean` `global change ecology`
:::

**Significance:** Shows that deep-ocean biodiversity faces increasing exposure to future warming, broadening climate-risk assessment beyond surface ecosystems.

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41558-020-0773-5)
:::

::: {.publication}
::: {.pub-meta}
**First author** · *Trends in Ecology & Evolution* · 2018
:::

### Climate velocity can inform conservation in a warming world.

**Brito-Morales I**, Garcia Molinos J, Schoeman DS, Burrows MT, Poloczanska ES, Brown CJ, Ferrier S, Harwood TD, Klein CJ, McDonald-Madden E, Moore PJ, Pandolfi JM, Watson JEM, Wenger AS, Richardson AJ. *Trends in Ecology & Evolution* 33, 441-457.

::: {.tag-row}
`climate velocity` `conservation science` `climate adaptation` `spatial ecology`
:::

**Significance:** Synthesizes how climate velocity can guide conservation decisions as species and environmental conditions move under climate change.

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tree.2018.03.009)
:::

::: {.publication}
::: {.pub-meta}
**Co-author** · conceptual/methods contributor · *Trends in Ecology & Evolution* · 2023
:::

### Demystifying global climate models for use in the life sciences.

Schoeman DS, Sen Gupta A, Harrison CS, Everett J, **Brito-Morales I**, Hannah L, Bopp L, Roehrdanz P, Richardson AJ. *Trends in Ecology & Evolution*.

::: {.tag-row}
`climate models` `biodiversity data science` `reproducible workflows`
:::

**Significance:** Helps ecologists and conservation scientists use global climate-model products more defensibly in biodiversity research.

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tree.2023.04.005)
:::

::: {.publication}
::: {.pub-meta}

:::

### Identifying marine climate refugia to advance climate-smart conservation.

Sanz-Martin M, Olguin-Jacobson C, Bolin JA, Quiles-Pons C, **Brito-Morales I**, Garcia Molinos J, Hidalgo M, Alabia ID, Gissi E, Provost MM, Micheli F, Arafeh-Dalmau N. *Trends in Ecology & Evolution*. In press.

::: {.tag-row}

## Research Outputs Beyond Papers

::: {.publication-list}
::: {.publication}
### Ocean Downscaling Viewer

Interactive Shiny tool for inspecting high-resolution derived ocean products, including baseline and future layers, depth zones, regional overlays, and summary statistics.

::: {.tag-row}
`R/Shiny` `climate downscaling` `decision support`
:::

[Open app](https://isaakbm-ocean-downscaling-viewer.share.connect.posit.cloud/)
:::

::: {.publication}
### Megafauna Data Viewer

Interactive Shiny tool for filtering, mapping, and reviewing marine megafauna occurrence records for the Save the Blue 5 project.

::: {.tag-row}
`R/Shiny` `marine megafauna` `biodiversity data`
:::

[Open app](https://isaakbm-megafauna-data-viewer.share.connect.posit.cloud/) | [Save the Blue 5](https://savethebluefive.net/)
:::
:::
